maya: quick UX note — when you open the compare table with filters on, the left rail and the badges feel like they fight for attention. screenshot attached :point_down: maya: https://redwood.slack-files/screenshot-compare.png chad: agree. feels visually heavy. my instinct: compress badges into a single compact column with an overflow hover to expand. reduces row height. liam: +1 for compression but we need to keep keyboard discoverability. if we collapse badges into an overflow, ensure the overflow is focusable and aria-label explains counts. sophie: also the version pinning copy is confusing — right now it shows "pinned to v2" but doesn't indicate scope (is it route or user?). we should change to "Pinned (route)" or "Pinned for you" depending on context. maya: good call. i keep assuming it's global and end up unpinning others' work. chad: what about an inline microcopy on hover: "Pinned for this catalog view" — small and contextual. sophie: and a lighter visual treatment for pinned rows — maybe a subtle left border instead of a full highlight. avoids competing with perf badges. liam: accessibility nit: when you toggle a filter chip, NVDA doesn't announce result count change. we should fire an ARIA live region update with the new total. maya: yes — something like: "Results updated: 42 models match". visible for screen readers only. console-bot: AB test "compact-badges-v1" scheduled for 2024-07-12 18:00 UTC. rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. chad: another thought — performance badges currently use color + icon. for colorblind users, add a label or alternate pattern. maybe badge text like "3ms" or "low" alongside color. sophie: prefer explicit text. color + icon as secondary. also ensure contrast ratios for badge backgrounds meet AA. liam: quick code snippet for aria live (proposed): liam: ```html
Results updated: 42 models
``` maya: love it. last UX edge: compare selection mode — when you select multiple rows the toolbar pushes content down and causes layout jump. can we make the toolbar overlay instead? chad: overlay makes sense. make sure it doesn't obscure row actions; anchor it to top of table with safe margin. sophie: copy tweak for the compare CTA: change "Compare" to "Compare versions" when multiple versions are selected — clearer. maya: thanks all. i'll put a small PR with: compact badge column option, pinned-scope microcopy, aria-live for counts, and overlay compare toolbar. pairing w/ @liam for the accessibility bits. liam: happy to pair. :+1: chad: will mock the compressed badge hover interaction and share later today. :eyes: console-bot: Note: UX review meeting added — #product — 2024-07-10 16:00 UTC. Attach agenda in the thread. maya: adding agenda: 1) badge compression mock 2) pin scope copy options 3) keyboard + aria walkthrough 4) AB rollout plan.
